subject: Post-call: FinTechCo trial playbook, success checkpoints & milepost schedule
messages:
From: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:42:00 -0500
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC playbook and mileposts

Hi Elena — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed trial playbook so we can lock dates and owners. Please confirm or flag anything that needs to change.

Summary of ask (from your side):
- Validate Redwood inference for secure on-prem data handling and latency under 150ms p95 for document search flows.
- Evaluate semantic search + embeddings for 10M docs (sample subset) and reranking for top-N quality.
- Confirm integration approach for data ingestion and redaction.

Proposed success criteria (candidate list):
1) p95 token latency < 150ms on the evaluation workload (excluding network).
2) Embedding recall@10 >= 0.82 against your ground-truth set.
3) End-to-end integration demo: ingest -> index -> query -> rerank with sample dashboard and callouts on cost.
4) No PII leakage in model outputs for the sample dataset (redaction validation).

POC timeline & mileposts (proposed):
- Kickoff (internal+customer): Tue, Nov 30, 2026 — 11:00 AM ET. Agenda: scope, data paths, security checklist, immediate blockers.
- Week 1 (Dec 1–7): Data ingest + environment setup (redwood allocates dedicated eval pool). Owner: David Kim (Redwood); Customer lead: Marco.
- Week 2 (Dec 8–14): Baseline model runs, latency profiling, initial embeddings. Owner: Stephanie Nguyen.
- Week 3 (Dec 15–21): Reranking experiments, quality readout, security validation. Owner: Marissa Cole.
- Final readout: Fri, Dec 22, 2026 — 10:00 AM ET (customer-facing demo + decision checkpoint).

Attachments I will share after this email: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (M.A.P.), acceptance_criteria draft, and a sample ingestion manifest.

Open items / asks for your team before kickoff:
- Confirm the sample dataset (we discussed ~100k records for perf + 10k labeled queries). Please share the upload link or S3 creds.
- Who is the customer engineer who will attend weekly check-ins (Marco?) and legal contact for the data processing note.
- Any compliance artifacts we should review beforehand (SOC2 scope, contracts).

Next steps: I’ll create a shared Drive folder and send calendar invites for kickoff + weekly 30-min check-ins. If Nov 30 works, I’ll reserve a small dedicated GPU pool for the first two weeks.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
David Kim
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
David.Kim@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0112
From: Elena Rossi <elena@fintechco.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Giannetti <marco@fintechco.com>, legal@fintechco.com, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 14:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC playbook and mileposts

David — thanks for the thorough recap. This aligns with what we discussed. A few notes from our side:

- Confirmed attendees: Marco (eng lead) will own data ingest and will be on the kickoff; legal included for the data processing note.
- Success criteria tweaks: for recall@10 we prefer a target of 0.80 minimum (we can iterate to 0.82 if initial runs warrant), and we want an explicit SLA for no PII exposure during runs (we will provide a small labeled PII set for validation).
- Final readout: Dec 22 works for us.

We can do kickoff Nov 30 at 11 AM ET. I’ll ask Marco to prepare the S3 creds and upload the initial sample by Nov 25. I’m attaching a short internal checklist (see attachment: fintechco_onboarding_checklist.pdf).

Elena
Head of AI Engineering

- Stephanie will lead quality metrics and build the evaluation dashboard (we’ll track p95 latency, recall@10, cost per 1k tokens).
